description.zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址。
description.en: The callback URL for the job result. Only HTTP URLs are supported.

description.zh: 待提取版权水印文件的输入OSS地址。
description.en: The OSS URL of the input file.

description.zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。

  - v1：长视频版权提取接口。
  - v2：短视频版权提取接口。
description.en:
The parameters for the watermarking job, specified as a JSON string. It supports the following parameter:

- `algoType`: The algorithm to use. Default value: v1.

  - `v1`: For long-form videos.

  - `v2`: For short-form videos.

description.zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入。
description.en: A publicly accessible URL for the video. If this parameter is specified, this URL is used as the job input and takes precedence over the Input parameter.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节。
description.en: The custom data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交版权水印提取作业
title.en: Submit a Copyright Watermark Extraction Job

descriptions.zh:
- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）地域使用。
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027615~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询版权水印提取作业](~~2834790~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- Currently, digital watermarking operations are supported only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.

- This is an [asynchronous operation](~~3027615~~). After you submit a request, the system returns a job ID and queues the job for background processing. You can obtain the final result through a callback notification, or call the [QueryCopyrightExtractJob](~~2834790~~) operation to query the job status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts submit-copyright-extract-job --input Bucket_:_example_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.mp4 --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --user-data 123 --params algoType_:_v1 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
